item.title: Japan’s Katayama warns that all options open to aid Japanese Yen
item.description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said that all options, including direct currency intervention, are available for dealing with recent weakness in the Japanese Yen (JPY), Bloomberg reported on Friday.

item.title: Gold holds losses near $4,600 amid increased safe-haven demand
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its losses for the second successive session, trading around $4,590 on Friday. The prices of precious metals, including Gold, fall amid decreasing safe-haven demand as geopolitical risks in Iran temporarily ease.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Constructive outlook prevails, first upside barrier emerges near 106.50
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross loses ground to near 106.10 during the early Asian session on Friday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) on the intervention fears from Japanese officials.

item.title: Exxon Mobil (XOM) Elliott Wave outlook impulsive rally signals trend continuation [Video]
item.description: Exxon Mobil (XOM) has reached a new all‑time high, confirming that bullish momentum has returned. The near‑term cycle, which began from the November 26, 2025 low, is unfolding as a five‑wave impulse.
